## Hi3D models (download them yourself)

| File | Folder |
| --- | --- |
| Hi3D `transformer_512/model.safetensors` + `config.json` | `models/diffusion_models/hi3d/transformer_512/` |
| Hi3D `transformer_1024/model.safetensors` + `config.json` | `models/diffusion_models/hi3d/transformer_1024/` |
| Hi3D `vae/model.safetensors` + `config.json` | `models/vae/hi3d/` |
| DINOv2-large `model.safetensors` (facebook/dinov2-large) | `models/clip_vision/dinov2-large/` |
| CLIP ViT-L/14 `model.safetensors` (openai/clip-vit-large-patch14) | `models/clip_vision/clip-vit-large-patch14/` |

Hi3D files: https://huggingface.co/hi3d-official/Hi3Dv1.0 (Hi3D Open License 1.0).
Any folder and file name works; pick the files in the loaders.

**Resolution**: 512 = 1 pass, 1024 = 2 passes (default), 1536 = 3 passes (data-center GPUs).
Use fp8 weight_dtype on the transformer loaders to save VRAM.

The coarse mesh comes from ComfyUI's native Hunyuan3D 2.0 subgraph (checkpoint hunyuan3d-dit-v2_fp16.safetensors in models/checkpoints, or Hunyuan3D-2mini as in the Hi3D release demo). Native Hunyuan3D meshes have X and Z swapped, so **coarse_mesh_axes** is set accordingly.
